annotations.title: Reorder a record through a view

description: Moves one record on a view's own "reorder": true field — the collection's own rankable number field, written through the SAME record-update door a plain edit uses. move: "up" or "down" swaps rank with its one neighbour in the view's own order (refused, no_neighbour, already first/last); position sets the rank directly to a number you choose. Refused if the view declares no "reorder": true. Development only — Live reorder goes through the dashboard; this tool doesn't reach Live yet. On the founder's Logs.

position.description: an exact rank value — send this instead of move
